head: b374b0fa65f742f101fb267bc0ba4a5bef0a542f
claim: On the loopback bench (capture/cloud-pair-receipt.mjs bench: fake provider and fake SSH transport, no Boat machine, no Boat key, no spend), setup() secures a cloud computer over SSH instead of a tailnet: it fails at securing while nothing listens on the app port, then the securing step carries the pinned SSH route, the pair receipt carries urls ws://127.0.0.1:7300 and the ssh route, a real @byokit/pair DeviceLink links through sshResolve with only the receipt and answers one request, a stranger phone is refused, and no Tailscale command runs beyond the old-drop-in check

steps.start: Repository worktree on fm/byk-cloud-ssh-4 at b374b0fa, dependencies installed and packages built; no Boat machine, no Boat key, no network spend; nothing listening on the app port 7300.
steps: Read the done-done verify skill and the cloud phone-key enrol recipe (pair-receipt-bench sub-feature).
Ran the built loopback bench: node .agents/skills/done-done-verify-byokit/capture/cloud-pair-receipt.mjs bench, with its output written to a log.
Watched the setup() run against a fake provider and fake SSH transport: first with nothing listening on the app port, then with the SSH securing step, the pairing receipt and ready.
Linked a real @byokit/pair device through sshResolve using only the receipt and sent one get.state request.
Tried a stranger phone that holds the same receipt and watched it get refused.
Checked the Tailscale commands the run issued.
steps.result: The log shows the first attempt failing at securing (failed:securing:state.failed:true) while nothing listened on the port; the later run goes through securing:ssh:7300, pairing:receipt and ready, with the receipt's urls set to ws://127.0.0.1:7300 and an ssh route pinned to the host key (hostMatches true). The phone link is online over the SSH route, answers get.state, and the stranger is refused with 'link refused: removed'. The only Tailscale-named command run is the test -e check of the old drop-in file. The bench result is PASS with exit 0.

verdicts.seen: I read all 10 log records plus the EXIT line. The not-listening record shows failed:securing with nothing listening on the app port. The steps record shows securing:ssh:7300 then pairing:receipt then ready. The receipt has urls ["ws://127.0.0.1:7300"] and an ssh block with appPort 7300. link-status is ["online"] and a get.state request is sent. The stranger record says "link refused: removed". The tailscale-commands record lists only the test -e check on byokit.conf. result is PASS and EXIT=0. The capture does not show the single answered response, so the 'answers one request' part is only partly shown, which keeps some uncertainty. The outcome names a single scenario, so no parts are listed.
